benchmark: LoCoMo locomo10.json, categories 1-4: retrieval round 2 (evidence recall only, no reader/judge run)
hms_surface: hms-server memory API, 4 tokio workers, 4 work slots
machine: Apple M-series, 10 cores, shared host; accuracy only, no timing
metric: evidence recall: share of a question's annotated evidence turns among the memories given to the reader under the 1764 o200k-token cap, k=30 hybrid recall per speaker (text-embedding-3-small, blend)
protocol: Levers defined and grids written before measuring; chosen on the 3 tuning conversations; held-out 7 scored once per final candidate; each candidate also gated on LongMemEval dev (must not drop). Evidence annotations used only to score and to classify misses; no question text, answers or outcomes in any retrieval code or parameter.

levers.episode: memory-API recall option (not shipped): within the 100-candidate pool, score += weight * best score among the other candidates with the same event time, then re-sort
levers.pack: adapter packing under the same cap: round-robin by rank (#236); cosine = both speakers merged by raw query cosine; zipper = each speaker keeps recall order, the next slot goes to the speaker whose next memory has the higher cosine

longmemeval_dev_gate.metric: answer-session recall any/all at k facts (single tenant: k = 5, 10, 30; two tenants: total cut 5, 10, 20)
longmemeval_dev_gate.invalid_runs: a first episode pair also ingested assistant turns without embeddings (any@5 .94->.87, all@5 .78->.64); discarded as mixed hybrid/lexical

decisions.cosine packing: rejected: within-list cosine reorder drops LongMemEval dev any@5 .82 -> .75
decisions.zipper packing: rejected without a held-out look: two-tenant LongMemEval analog drops at cuts 5 and 10 (all@5 .66 -> .63)

judge_accuracy: unchanged from locomo_v1.json: no candidate passed the gates, so no reader/judge run
